verified_facts.text: Oscar de la Renta drew on his Dominican roots in designing the villas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Drawing inspiration from his Dominican roots, he infused each villa with a captivating blend of simplicity and sophistication

verified_facts.text: Tortuga Bay sits in a private enclave within Puntacana Resort and has 13 villas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tortuga Bay is situated in a private enclave within the resort and offers 13 luxurious villas

verified_facts.text: Rooms are decorated with locally sourced materials and have coralline-stone bathrooms, a kitchenette and an oak walk-in closet.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each room includes a comfortable kitchenette, luxurious coralline-stoned bathrooms, and an oak wood walk-in closet

verified_facts.text: Guests are given electric golf carts and bicycles to get around the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests are provided with electrical golf carts and bicycles for convenient, eco-friendly travel around the resort

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a pool, Jacuzzi and beach reserved exclusively for Tortuga Bay guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel also features a pool, Jacuzzi, and beach exclusively for Tortuga Bay guests

verified_facts.text: Every room is assigned an Embajador, a personal host.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every room is assigned an Embajador to ensure guests can rest and rejuvenate while spending time in paradise

verified_facts.text: Two Bedroom Suites are oceanfront with direct access to Tortuga Bay's private beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: The luxurious oceanfront villas offer direct access to Tortuga's pristine private beach

verified_facts.text: Junior Suites are on the second floor with a private balcony and ocean or oceanfront views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Situated on the second floor, these rooms boast a private balcony offering stunning ocean or oceanfront views

verified_facts.text: In the Three Bedroom Villa, the third bedroom is reached by an exterior staircase for privacy.
verified_facts.excerpt: the third bedroom is conveniently accessed via an exterior staircase, offering a secluded retreat within the villa's serene surroundings

verified_facts.text: Bamboo restaurant combines locally sourced food with Mediterranean influences in a setting designed by Oscar de la Renta.
verified_facts.excerpt: The unique menu combines locally sourced food with Mediterranean influences to offer a variety of innovative fusion dishes in a cozy, graceful setting designed by Oscar de la Renta

verified_facts.text: Tortuga Bay Lounge, beside Bamboo, is known for hand-rolled cigars and fine spirits.
verified_facts.excerpt: The lounge is renowned for its hand-rolled cigars and an impressive selection of fine spirits

verified_facts.text: La Yola serves Mediterranean cuisine and seafood and is designed to resemble a fishing boat in the Puntacana Resort Marina.
verified_facts.excerpt: La Yola is designed to resemble a fishing boat, which is nestled within the picturesque Puntacana Resort Marina

verified_facts.text: In-room dining is available 24 hours a day.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests can indulge in a wide range of in-room dining choices available 24 hours a day

verified_facts.text: Arriving guests get VIP service through immigration, luggage retrieval and customs at Punta Cana airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: VIP service through immigration, luggage retrieval and customs

verified_facts.text: Round-trip private transportation between Punta Cana International Airport and the villa is provided.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Roundtrip private transportation between the Punta Cana International
Airport and your Tortuga Bay villa

verified_facts.text: The boutique among the villas displays creations by designer Silvia Tcherassi.
verified_facts.excerpt: displays the exquisite creations of internationally acclaimed designer Silvia Tcherassi

verified_facts.text: Guests get included access to the Ojos Indigenas Reserve.
verified_facts.excerpt: our guests enjoy included access to the Ojos Indígenas Reserve

verified_facts.text: The Ojos Indigenas reserve has 12 freshwater lagoons.
verified_facts.excerpt: the reserve is distinguished by its 12 freshwater lagoons

verified_facts.text: Puntacana Resort & Club has 45 holes of championship golf on Tom Fazio's Corales and P.B. Dye's La Cana.
verified_facts.excerpt: Puntacana Resort & Club features 45 holes of championship golf with six oceanfront and 14 oceanview holes on Tom Fazio's Corales and P.B. Dye's La Cana.

verified_facts.text: The Oscar de la Renta Tennis Center has tennis, paddle and pickleball courts and a Technogym.
verified_facts.excerpt: ten meticulously maintained tennis courts, four paddle courts, two pickleball courts, and a fully equipped Technogym

verified_facts.text: Water sports on the beaches include snorkeling, kayaking and paddleboarding.
verified_facts.excerpt: partake in various water sports, such as snorkeling, kayaking, and paddleboarding

verified_facts.text: The resort has the Puntacana Equestrian Center and Puntacana Polo Club, with polo lessons available.
verified_facts.excerpt: Improve your polo skills in the tranquil and breathtaking setting of the Puntacana Polo Club

verified_facts.text: The Spa is located in La Cana Club and offers treatments, holistic techniques and yoga classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in La Cana Club, the spa offers a variety of treatments, holistic techniques, and yoga classes

verified_facts.text: Children up to 4 years old stay free with their parents.
verified_facts.excerpt: Children up to 4 years old can stay with their parents for free.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has its own private beach patrolled by lifeguards.
verified_facts.excerpt: We have our own private beach and it is patrolled by lifeguards.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not offer day passes.
verified_facts.excerpt: We do not have day offers.

verified_facts.text: Tortuga Bay opened in 2006, designed by Dominican fashion designer Oscar de la Renta.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tortuga Bay Puntacana opened in 2006, designed by the late Dominican fashion designer Oscar de la Renta.

verified_facts.text: Tortuga Bay sits on 1,300 feet of private beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tortuga Bay Puntacana sits on 1,300 feet of private beach with clean white sand and turquoise water

verified_facts.text: The 13 villas are sunshine yellow and rise from a lawn that flows onto the sand.

verified_facts.text: Bamboo's dining room has blush pink walls, a color handpicked by Oscar de la Renta.

verified_facts.text: Staff stock rooms in advance with toys or gear suited to children's ages.
verified_facts.excerpt: The staff will stock the rooms in advance with toys or gear appropriate for their age.
